claim: At Eva Levante, Crypto Shift bought for 570 Glimmer: the purchase request reached the server, the Glimmer went from 24,430 to 23,860, the acquisition notice showed and the emblem is marked owned (the server's response applied by hand)
At Eva Levante, Command and Crypto Shift bought with the server applying each purchase itself: Glimmer 25,000 to 24,430 to 23,860, acquisition notices, emblems owned
The PC mouse moves the game's menu cursor and turns the camera in a match, through the emulator's new detours (opt-in)
With the 60 Hz game clock and the fixed-clock override off, the game's own tick count advanced 0.99 game seconds per real second in a Moon match; 60 fps in menus and orbit, mid-30s in busy scenes

The game's own PC keyboard layer reads the keyboard: with W removed from the emulator's controller mapping, holding W walked the Guardian 10.2 m in 2 s, the same as the stick; R switched weapons rather than reloading, so the game's default key bindings are still to be mapped
Through the game's own key layer, T plays the wave emote (the game reports "D1Guardian waves") and G the sit emote; in third person the Guardian is drawn with a head (the served mask's horned crest)
